titles.name: Claws & Magic
titles.description: Third-person anthro fantasy melee: swords, bows, guns and magic. Eight heroes, Horde co-op with a Cerberus boss every 10 waves, three maps and online duels.

titles.name: PonySide
titles.description: PonySide is a 2D top-down fantasy RPG built for cooperative multiplayer adventure. Create your own unique character, team up with friends, and explore a world filled with danger, mystery, and opportunity. Free to play on Steam.
